worlds.name: Floofer Cloud
worlds.curatedDescription: The Floofers' ancestral home, a distant realm of very soft, fluffy ground wrapped in a golden sparkly mist. Its inhabitants are tiny living pom-poms that bounce sky-high, shooting straight up and floating back down. They are so bursting with energy that they cannot stop jumping long enough to fall asleep, even when utterly exhausted.

potion.name: The golden sparkles potion
potion.rhyme: One so manya know, one so manya know, one so manya know.
potion.mechanic: Each traveler takes a sip of the sparkly golden teleportation potion and says the rhyme three times, vanishing in a poof and reappearing in the land of the Floofers.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Maybe the Floofer Cloud.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Very good, and they can jump so high. Be careful, those are rough, Floofers.

worlds.name: Prehistoric World
worlds.curatedDescription: An ancient world reached by drinking Isabella's prehistoric-animals potion, which smells like ancient prehistoric creatures and mastodon fur. It is home to a meat-loving T-Rex, a slow, tea-drinking giant sloth who lives in a burrow, a woolly mammoth, and a fierce smilodon that turns out to just want belly rubs. Seeker, Jane, and a rainbow of Frasgles explore it, scaring off the scariest creatures with their loudest shouts before taking a going-home potion.

potion.name: Prehistoric animals potion
potion.rhyme: Slime, slime, slime... slime-kabime, slime-kabime, seem-kabine, slime.
potion.mechanic: Everyone takes turns sipping Isabella's prehistoric-animals potion and then says the rhyme all together to appear in prehistoric world, with a going-home potion to return.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: "Welcome to my sloth burrow. You see that hole in the ground over there? That's where I live. Would you like to come in for a cup of tea?"

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Silver can't make potions.

stories.title: Prehistoric Potion Adventures

worlds.name: Underwater Coral Reef Gemstone World
worlds.curatedDescription: A vibrant submerged realm of coral and sparkling gemstones, reached by drinking a light-blue, fishy-smelling potion with little glittering sparkles from a diamond-shaped bottle. Seeker and Dimitar appear beneath the surface, but Dimitar's sudden coral allergy forces a sneezing retreat up onto the rocks and sand. Back on the surface, two little tropical fish, one red and one blue, turn up tangled in Seeker's beard and are adopted as pets.

potion.name: Diamond-shaped potion
potion.rhyme: Sparkle, sparkle, sparkle, sparkle, sparkle, sparkle.
potion.mechanic: A sip of the sparkly, fishy-smelling diamond-shaped potion followed by the spoken rhyme teleports the drinker into the underwater gemstone reef in a sparkle and a splash.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Can't drink any of the sparkles. Be careful.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Let's name them Mooscafour, that's, that's the red one's name, and Sinafia for short for the blue one.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I think I'm allergic to the coral.

Slime-Ka-Bye: The Beard-Dweller's Deep Sea Adventure
Disco and Thisco's Deep-Sea Submarine Adventure

worlds.name: Kingdom of the Sea Mice
worlds.curatedDescription: A mysterious kingdom of tiny sea mice hidden on the absolute ocean floor, deep in the crushing silence of the deep dark. To reach it, a submersible dives down out of the bright, sparkling sunlit zone into ever colder, darker water, gliding past sleepy deep-sea creatures like a grumpy anglerfish, all the way to the bottom of the sea where the Sea Mice live.

potion.mechanic: No potion - a crewed submersible dives from the sunlit zone down through the cold, dark abyss to the Sea Mice's kingdom on the ocean floor.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: We're just going... I don't know. Maybe we're going to, we're going to the bottom of the sea, to the, the bottom of the sea where the Kingdom of the Sea Mice live.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I see, I see a big angler fishy.

stories.title: Voyage to the Kingdom of the Sea Mice
Disco and Thisco's Deep-Sea Submarine Adventure

worlds.name: Planet of the Mookers
worlds.curatedDescription: An enigmatic alien world with a fuzzy yet curiously slimy surface, the ancestral cradle of the blue, friendly Mookers, moose-like creatures who talk in a rhythmic chorus of "mooks." Everything there is so slimy that visitors end up covered in sticky goo. The realm is strewn with the colossal remains of giant fossils and holds a library where ancient fossil books are kept, and it can be reached only by drinking a specific purple potion.

potion.name: purple potion
potion.rhyme: Planet of the Mookers, we're the Blue-kers.
potion.mechanic: Take a sip of the purple potion and say the rhyme, and you sploop right down onto the slimy Mooker surface.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I am, I'm Wobbly Whiskers. I can't find my mommy again.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: But I'm so slimy.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Mook, mook, mook. I'll be moo- I'll be the Floofers, you'll be the Mookers.

worlds.name: Balloon World
worlds.curatedDescription: Balloon World is a whimsical realm where everything is made of balloons, from the springy, rubbery, bouncy ground and rolling hills to its towering architecture and inflated delicacies. Its denizens include squeaking balloon dogs like Squeaky, who works at the Balloon Twisting School, and it is ruled by a giant rainbow-balloon King who wears an orange ring of balloons as a crown. Wonders include the majestic Balloon Castle and a balloon farm growing balloon strawberries and other balloon fruits and vegetables. It is the birthplace of the kitten Jinjar, infamously known as the 'Sneaky Popper.'

potion.name: Balloon World potion
potion.rhyme: Balloon Baboon, Balloon Baboon, Balloon Baboon.
potion.mechanic: Take a sip of the rubbery, silvery, all-colored potion and say the rhyme three times, and with a pop Seeker's house vanishes and you reappear in Balloon World.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Balloon World, where everything's made of balloons.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Hi, balloon dog. We brought a, a lone balloon.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: We drink the potion and do the special rite called Balloon Baboon.

The Sneaky Popper of Balloon World
A Sticky Adventure to the Castle of Slime
The Bouncy Adventures in Balloon World

worlds.name: Slime World
worlds.curatedDescription: Slime World is a vibrant, magical realm where the landscape is sculpted from iridescent orange and blue slime, a viscous dimension that is wonderfully bouncy yet incredibly sticky, so lifting a foot goes 'shloop' and every fall rebounds softly. At its center stands a big, ball-shaped castle made of orange and blue slime, filled with fuzzy ball creatures called Snooper-ka-floopers (the Floofers' next cousins) and ruled by the Queen of Slime World. It is home to the blue-and-green alien Sneeter and hosts a Slime School, where students mix baking soda, glue and food coloring into gooey creations before bouncing through the sticky hills.

potion.rhyme: Slime bo-bime, slime bo-bime, slime bo-bime!
potion.mechanic: Sip the slimy orange-and-blue potion Isabella made (slime mixed with water, blue coloring, and frozen in an ice cube) and recite the rhyme to be transported to Slime World.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: It's so bouncy.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Boing, boing, boing, boing, boing, boing, boing, boing, boing up the stairs. And in the bathroom and everywhere there was a Snooper Kaflooper.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Yeah, but what about an apron to keep my other apron dry?

stories.title: A Sticky Adventure to the Castle of Slime
The Magic of Slime School

worlds.name: Kibble World
worlds.curatedDescription: A magical land where everything—houses, trees, clouds, and even the bowls—is made of edible, kibble-colored kibble. When thirty hungry cats arrive, the local Silvercat welcomes them to feast, and they run in all directions sniffing, nibbling, and munching until their bellies are full, then curl up for a long, peaceful nap in the crunchy landscape.

potion.name: Kibble World potion
potion.mechanic: Seeker blends kibble, wet food, cat fur, and cat feeders into a potion; everyone takes a sip and says the rhyme to appear in Kibble World.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Kibble, kibble, too much... There has to be too much kibble in the potion.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Big pile of kibble. Big... There was lots of everything. Everything was made out of kibble.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Well, Cavilver had a velvet belly.

stories.title: The Thirty Cats of Kibble World

worlds.name: Cheese World
worlds.curatedDescription: A whole world of delicious cheese as far as the eye can see: mountains of cheddar, great boulders of Gouda, sidewalks of shredded cheese, and mozzarella cheese trains (Dimitar drives one) that you may nibble, but not eat up. At Cheese Beach the sand is grated Parmesan and the ocean is warm, gooey, stinky soft cheese, perfect for a mouse learning to swim, if you keep an eye out for the sticky American cheese shark. When it rains, it rains about a million french fries.

potion.name: Cheese World potion
potion.mechanic: Seeker keeps the Cheese World potion on the yellow shelf of his potion closet. Everyone takes one little sip (don't drink it all, Tot!) and says the rhyme, and with a squish they appear in Cheese World.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Okay, so Cheese World has, like, about a million french fries when it's raining, and today is not raining in Cheese World, so no. So we can still go there, and, um-

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: And the sidewalk was made of shredded cheese.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: And Dimitar said one more thing, "You may take a little nibble, but don't eat up the whole cheese train 'cause then it won't be able to take passengers somewhere."

stories.title: Tot's Great Cheese Beach Adventure

worlds.name: The Deep Deep Dark
worlds.curatedDescription: Down past the slimy kelp forest, at the very bottom of a deep ocean trench, lies the Deep Deep Dark, where it is so dark you need a flashlight and most creatures are fast asleep. Izzy the Kiddo leads the way with her shining light. Down here live friendly sharks of every kind (the Whale Shark, the Cookie Cutter Shark, a tiny Pocket Shark, and a Blackbelly Lanternshark who lost his glow), and Ms. Clam, who couldn't sleep until her lost pearl was found in the mud.

potion.name: Muddy maple-syrup potion
potion.rhyme: Fish to pish, fish to pish, fish to pish.
potion.mechanic: Seeker and Dimitar boiled feathers, red apples and other odd ingredients into a brand-new potion that looked and smelled like mud (with a hint of maple syrup). One sip, the rhyme, and kersploosh: the Deep Deep Dark. On other trips the friends simply swim down, following Izzy’s flashlight.

worlds.arrivalFrom: Seeker's Castle / Potion Closet, or swimming down from the ocean

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Um, "I can help you. I can help you. Here, here's my very b- bright flashlight. It's red."

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: "Hello, my name is Whale Shark. I am very friendly. You can even swim with me."

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Even deeper, because at the bottom of the trench is finally the deep, deep dark. And so they all bravely followed Izzy, who was leading them with her light, swimming straight down into the trench, all the way down into the deep, deep dark.

Shark Friends and the Deep Deep Dark

worlds.name: Merworld
worlds.curatedDescription: The home of the Mergirls at the bottom of the ocean. Blue, Yellow and Pink Mergirl live in a house with a beautiful kelp forest in the backyard, Rainbow Mergirl has a kelp forest (and a castle) of her own, and Crabby lives next door. Kelp keeps going missing, nibbled by hungry bears and Kelp Basses, so the Mergirls plant new kelp farms big enough for everyone. When Green Mergirl's tail turned the wrong color, Seeker's ancient spellbook and a giant rainbow bubble bath set her right.

potion.mechanic: No potion needed: the Mergirls simply live here, at the bottom of the ocean.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: "I mean gone, my merkelp forest is gone."

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: It begins, the mergirls were in their house.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: 'Cause it's not even Christmas le- yet, so I want the healing tail spell.

worlds.name: Mars
worlds.curatedDescription: A primordial red world of red rocks and dust underfoot, resting beneath a strange reddish-pink sky dotted with little wispy clouds. Being smaller than Earth, it has less gravity, so everyone feels lighter and can jump higher, and dust storms sweep across its ancient dormant volcanoes and impact craters. There is no air to breathe on Mars, so travelers carry a magic bubble of comfortable air with them; it is the home of Julian.

potion.name: Mars potion
potion.mechanic: Each traveler takes a sip of the swirling, spiraling red-orange-yellow-and-black potion, chants the magic spell three times, and a big zoom-pow sets them down on Mars inside a magic bubble of breathable air.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: ... 'cause, Seeker, I wanted the planet potion 'cause I have planets on my dress, including one that's red.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I notice that the planet that we're on is Mars. It's red, like yellowy orangy, too.

worlds.name: The Moon
worlds.curatedDescription: Visible from Earth as a pockmarked sphere of gray, white, and black, the Moon is a low-gravity world where visitors bounce as they walk. A big round gray-and-white-and-black circle in the sky, it is a waypoint for sun-bound crews and a playground of ancient space rocks and leaping Floofers. Its silver dust is where the long-lost mother cat is finally found.

potion.mechanic: Reached not by potion but by a homemade cardboard rocket ship that blasts off from Mars and dodges asteroids before landing on the Moon.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: There is no gravity, so you bounce when you walk around on the moon.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Um, they hopped everywhere looking for Mom until they spot a small black cat far away on the moon.

worlds.name: Rainbow Planet Vupiter Wupiter Snupiter
worlds.curatedDescription: A vibrant planet covered in swirling colors of red, orange, yellow, green, and purple, first spotted from a spaceship as a tiny glowing speck covered with swirling colors. It is the home of a family of space rocks, and travelers navigate through its swirling colorful clouds to deliver the baby space rock Moueks safely back to its family.

potion.mechanic: Reached not by potion but by a rocket ship that blasts off from Earth and fires its engines across deep space, with a magical rope trailing behind to guide the crew home again.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: They live on the Rainbow Planet Whoopiter, Whoopiter Snoopiter.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: This rope will help us find our way back to Earth.

stories.title: Mission to the Rainbow Planet Vupiter Wupiter Snupiter

worlds.name: Star World
worlds.curatedDescription: A breathtaking cosmic dimension set in the dark expanse of space, where travelers float in darkness surrounded on every side by the night sky full of tiny twinkling lights. It is home to the cat-like Mookers, and in Star World you can zoom across the cosmos very fast, star to star. At its heart glows a wise, ancient star, billions of years old, who watches planets come and go in a blink.

potion.name: Star potion
potion.rhyme: Subime, subime, subime, subime, subime, subime, subime.
potion.mechanic: Everyone takes a sip of the glittery star potion (ground-up cardboard stars, glitter, grinded-up gems, and feathers) and chants the rhyme, and with a whoosh and a twinkle they arrive.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: These are stars with seven points.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I wanna see one of the stars.

stories.title: The Magic Star Potion and the Journey to Star World

worlds.name: Cat World
worlds.curatedDescription: A tactile, fur-filled dimension reachable only through specialized teleportation potions, a plush realm for those who master alchemical teleportation. It is home to cats who speak in meows, purrs, and the occasional 'hate,' including a kitten named Silver who cannot open her own cans of food. To help, the wizard Seeker leaves behind a magical can opener that makes a 'snergle' sound, so the cats of Cat World can learn to feed themselves.

potion.mechanic: You drink the oval, tube-shaped teleportation potion and say the rhyme three times to appear in Cat World.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: A potion is something you drink, and once you say a rhyme three times, then you'll appear in, in a world.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: That means I got my claw stuck

The Thirty Cats of Kibble World

worlds.name: Rainbow Fruit World
worlds.curatedDescription: A world where every element of nature is made of a different fruit. A Grape Cat welcomes visitors to a land of forests whose trees are giant apples and bananas, a blueberry ocean with a pomegranate-seed beach, and waters where Pear Sharks and Lemon Fish swim. Fruit juice is a splashy hazard for anyone wearing clothes—though residents made of fruit don't mind at all.

potion.rhyme: Ding-dong cadong-dong, ding-dong cadong-dong, ding-dong cadong-dong.
potion.mechanic: You uncork one of Seeker's teeny-tiny rainbow-colored potion bottles (it smells of pear and lemon), take a sip, and Dimitar says the rhyme, zwooping everyone into Rainbow Fruit World.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: No, no, no, no. Oh, we could change the ocean to being blue- a blueberry of- with a pomegranate beach. What about that idea?

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Oh, also with pear sharks.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: ... you covered everyone with blueberry juice.

stories.title: The Rainbow Fruit World and the Great Lemon Fish Debate

worlds.name: Red Dot World
worlds.curatedDescription: Red Dot World is a raspberry-strawberry extravaganza where, in every direction as far as you can see, the ground is a soft, fluffy purple material dotted all over with little spots of red: raspberries, strawberries, currants, red grapes, cranberries, red floofberries, and red apples, anything red. Its one resident is a giant, friendly flying pterodactyl who has all the berries he could ever want but longs for meat and dreams of learning to dance. When Lottie the ballet-dancing bunny shares a picnic basket of meat and teaches him her moves, the lonely reptile of the berry world finds a friend.

potion.name: Red Dot World
potion.mechanic: One arrives by drinking a purple, swirly potion covered in red dots, its cork labeled 'Red Dot World', and reciting the rhyme.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: It's made of raspberries and strawberries.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: "Mm, we're fine walking, 'cause Lottie can dance anywhere."

stories.title: Seeker's Midnight Adventure and the Dancing Pterodactyl

worlds.name: Book World
worlds.curatedDescription: A world where everything is made of paper, pages, covers, and bindings—stacks, piles, and towers of gigantic and tiny books, with clouds of fluffy little books drifting through the sky. Its inhabitants are sentient 'book people' that waddle on tiny feet, such as a Penguin Book that reads itself aloud to answer questions and a sturdy Greenland Book that clomps about in big icy boots.

potion.rhyme: Sub-Ime, Sub-Ime, Sub-Ime, Sub-Ime, Sub-Ime, Sub-Ime, Sub-Ime.
potion.mechanic: Seeker grinds an old, moldy book into sparkly book dust and adds it to a potion of maple syrup, feathers, and water; everyone sips and chants the rhyme (twice through) to reach Book World.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: And were there any book people?

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: ... are you a peng- are you a penguin made out of books?

stories.title: The Sparkling Dust of Book World

worlds.name: Sleepy World
worlds.curatedDescription: Sleepy World is the coziest world in the universe: a dim, calm realm beneath a beautiful starry sky, where mountains and piles of soft blankets and pillows lie everywhere and cozy beds wait in every shape, size, and color. It is watched over by Saluska, a huge, fluffy, blue sleep dragon with big, droopy eyes whose warm body and deep voice make every visitor feel sleepy. Saluska makes a perfectly custom, cozy bed appear for each traveler, so they can curl up, imagine the worlds of their ancestors, and drift off to sleep.

potion.name: Sleepy World potion
potion.mechanic: One arrives by drinking a dark blue, swirly indigo potion speckled with glowing stars and saying the rhyme.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I want a pink bed with pink sheets with mice on them, and, um, a pink blanket with purple stars, and, um, a cozy blue pillow.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Okay. And so, um, Seeker and Hattie appeared in the coziest world in the universe. It was Sleepy World.

stories.title: The Cozy Potions of Sleepy World

worlds.name: Winterworld
worlds.curatedDescription: Winterworld is a freezing landscape of deep snow and drifting snowflakes, dotted with hidden, experimental ice towers. It is perilous enough to swallow a traveler whole: Seeker finds the mouse Winston buried beneath the snow after a snow-angel mishap. Bundled in a jacket, snow pants, boots, mittens, and his magic shining hat, Seeker digs Winston free and recovers the tiny ice towers he had been searching for, leftovers of his experiment to build one gigantic tower.

potion.name: Winterworld potion
potion.mechanic: One arrives by drinking the sparkling white snow potion while wearing all their winter gear.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: ... when I was making a snow angel.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: And I found some ice cubes, and I found some ice towers

stories.title: Winterworld Rescue and the Magic Shining Hat

worlds.name: Bead World
worlds.curatedDescription: A sparkling, colorful world where everything is made of beads. The hills are beads (round, so they're slippery to walk down), a stream of blue beads flows along like water and rattles as it goes, a bead bridge crosses it, and up the far hill is a sparkling forest made of beads too. The potion that brought everyone here was brewed in the brand-new potion factory across the street from Seeker's Castle, and it smelled just like roses.

potion.name: Rose-scented factory potion
potion.mechanic: Brewed in the new potion factory: heated in the Hotter-a-Totter, cooled with a kettle, and finished with a flower bead from the mysterious surprise level. One sip each, then the rhyme (said one time too many, oops) and plink! Everyone lands in Bead World.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: And is there pink sparkle, um, flower beads?

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And then there's a plink. And Dimitar, and Hattie, and Seeker, and Isabella all appear in a world that's sparkling and colorful. And as they look around, they realize that everything is made of beads.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: ... yeah. Zoe leads everyone down a hill all made of beads, which is kind of slippery, 'cause beads are round and slippery And then there's a stream made of blue beads that are flowing like water, and it's kind of noisy 'cause instead of water, it's beads and it goes, .

stories.title: The Potion Factory and the Journey to Bead World

worlds.name: Bee World
worlds.curatedDescription: A sip of a red swirly potion with white dots and five diamonds, a kabam, and you're tiny, standing under a field of flowers so gigantic that their stems look like tall green sticks. Bee World is the home of a hive of bees, and the bees here are as big as Isabella; one will give you a ride and share its nectar. It is also where Isabella first shouted "Blemus!" (superhero language for uh-oh) when Gravity Goldfish turned up, looking for a quiet place to nap.

potion.name: Red swirly potion
potion.rhyme: And kabam, and kabam, and kabam.
potion.mechanic: Find the red swirly potion with white dots and five diamonds in Seeker’s closet, take a sip, and say the rhyme: there’s a bazing, and you’re shrunk down to bee size.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Oh, it must be the bee world.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Bees, come on, come on out of your hive.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And then the buzzing got closer and louder, and then a gigantic bee that was this, that was so big, it was the same size as Isabella, landed in front of Isabella and Seeker. Bzz.

stories.title: Blemus! The Gravity Goldfish Is Coming
